    <rect id="c-proof" x="64" y="824" width="1432" height="224" data-content="• A reader locates the authoritative guide for an agreed task.<br>• A second reader completes it and gets the stated outcome.<br>• Scope, implementation version and verification date are visible.<br>• A sample system change triggers the right documentation update.<br>• Feedback, stale content and retired links reach an accountable owner." fill="#ddddd8" stroke="#a8a8a0" stroke-width="2" data-text-color="#434339" data-font-family="noto_sans" data-font-size="22" data-text-align="left" data-text-align-vertical="middle" data-miro-id="3458764690590635941" />
    <rect id="c-dependencies" x="1656" y="824" width="1432" height="224" data-content="• Access to existing Confluence/product and repository material.<br>• Verified configuration, release evidence and domain reviewers.<br>• Agreed environment/deployment workflows from related proposals.<br>• Time to exercise instructions in an approved environment.<br>• Team decisions on where the index, pages and tracked updates live." fill="#ddddd8" stroke="#a8a8a0" stroke-width="2" data-text-color="#434339" data-font-family="noto_sans" data-font-size="22" data-text-align="left" data-text-align-vertical="middle" data-miro-id="3458764690590635942" />
    <rect id="c-controls" x="64" y="1200" width="1432" height="224" data-content="• One authoritative source per topic; link rather than fork copies.<br>• Named content owner/reviewer and explicit page status.<br>• System-change impact checks and agreed handoff requirements.<br>• Periodic verification, overdue escalation and ownership transfer.<br>• Existing access boundaries; secret references rather than values." fill="#ffe86d" stroke="#cbb333" stroke-width="2" data-text-color="#574900" data-font-family="noto_sans" data-font-size="22" data-text-align="left" data-text-align-vertical="middle" data-miro-id="3458764690590635943" />
    <rect id="c-decisions" x="1656" y="1200" width="1432" height="224" data-content="• Which existing tool is the entry point and which content stays in code?<br>• Which DevOps guides and gaps come first?<br>• Who owns and approves each cloud/product subject area?<br>• What review cadence and freshness indicators are useful?<br>• How are updates tracked, prioritized and checked during delivery?" fill="#ffe86d" stroke="#cbb333" stroke-width="2" data-text-color="#574900" data-font-family="noto_sans" data-font-size="22" data-text-align="left" data-text-align-vertical="middle" data-miro-id="3458764690590635944" />
    <rect id="c-boundaries" x="64" y="1504" width="3024" height="160" data-content="<b>Review the direction before detailed documentation delivery</b><br>This proposal defines the information map and operating process. Detailed Confluence/runbook work follows the agreed review and implementation scope.<br>No tool migration, AI ingestion, repository consolidation, dates or named assignments are assumed; preserve access to each authoritative source." fill="#ddddd8" stroke="#a8a8a0" stroke-width="2" data-text-color="#434339" data-font-family="noto_sans" data-font-size="22" data-text-align="left" data-text-align-vertical="middle" data-miro-id="3458764690590635945" />
